records.notes: Medial nearly complete denudation of articular cartilage supplies severe loss and qualitative near-entire involvement. Lateral shallower fissures plus reduced cartilage thickness do not explicitly bind the maximum lost fraction; unnamed I–II does not independently define it. PF unnamed II–III and I–II grades with signal change/osteophytes also lack direct morphology and extent for the target threshold.

records.notes: Medial and PF diffuse mixed below-/above-half disease do not bound the extent of the qualifying deeper component. Lateral describes only low-grade disease; the same report explicitly defines the low/high pair as less/more than half in its PF sentence. This internal source definition supports lateral below-threshold negative. The contiguous quote retains that definition without borrowing an external grading scale.

records.notes: Medial explicitly long-segment full-thickness chondropathy with nearly exhausted cartilage supports severe depth and broad extent. Lateral osteophytes are informative degeneration without cartilage-depth or loss-region-size evidence. PF focal deep chondropathy lacks a qualifying region size; series/image coordinates are not lesion measurements.

records.notes: Medial diffuse high-grade disease and lateral diffuse damage establish cartilage abnormality/distribution but do not explicitly bind lost-thickness fraction.
